Initial run exposed two obsolete removed-allowance CLI expectations; corrected before this measurement. A subsequent passing run reused noninstrumented ordinary binaries and discovered historical objects; those invalid totals were retained locally and not published.

Before this final measurement, a scoped cargo clean --profile dev of the six workspace packages removed stale/uninstrumented workspace artifacts while preserving dependencies and release artifacts. Raw profiles were then cleared. cargo-llvm-cov 0.9.1 injects instrumentation through its rustc wrapper, so ordinary --no-clean artifacts must not be assumed instrumented.

Final export includes all 13 executed test binaries and three current production entry-point binaries (19 paths, 16 unique objects because three are hardlink aliases). All 471 source entries belong to the measured checkout except one unavailable distribution Rust standard-library source. No historical checkout source or mixed totals remain.
